answer_2.quote: We design an automated scoring pipeline (see Algorithm 1) to evaluate model-generated answers ... This method simplifies answers into two categories: numeric values, handled through floating-point operations, and symbolic expressions, requiring symbolic computation.

answer_4.quote: We do manual sampling check of GPT-4V for theorem proving problems with analysis reported at Section 5.1. ... We manually sample and check 97 maths (55 for English and 42 for Chinese) and 67 physics Olympiad-level open-ended problems that GPT-4V answered.
answer_4.guideline: Manual sampling and error analysis of model-generated answers.
